en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a large, ornate building with a prominent dome and classical architectural elements. The foreground shows a neatly landscaped area with stairs leading up to the building's entrance. The top right corner reads 'Zagreb' in red, with a handwritten date next to it. The lower left features the printed label 'Umjetnički pavillon,' and additional handwritten text is visible across the bottom.
